interpretation: The ILFORD Tc=Tm^P guidance compiles exactly into a positive monotone exposure-time primitive. Eleven named films collapse to seven exponent-equivalence groups, so this source does not by itself distinguish every named stock.
Kodak VISION3 50D is represented only by its March-2026 documented 1/1000-to-1-second no-correction interval. The compiler rejects rather than extrapolates beyond that interval.

The pass opens a synthetic local-incident-rate experiment because the ILFORD source explicitly states that highlight and shadow light levels can experience different reciprocity failure. It does not open photographic rendering or product integration.
next_leaf: U6.P2AB freeze and test a local-intensity reciprocity contrast operator against global-time correction, exponent-1 identity and wrong-exponent controls.
claim_ceiling: First-party formula compiler and documented identity interval for exposure-time mechanics; not colour-film reciprocity, particular-roll/process calibration, scanner response, photographic quality or product promotion.
